en: Sepia-toned image of a large brick ruin with a tall, steeply gabled end wall. The wall has multiple small rectangular and arched window openings arranged symmetrically, with three tall Gothic-style lancet windows at the lower center. On both sides of the central gable stretch long, high brick walls, also in ruin, forming what looks like the nave of a former church or abbey. There are small figures and an umbrella or kiosk visible near the central opening, emphasizing the monument's touristic character. No visible caption or printed text is present on the image side.
